note: In-game Cookbook (David's videos, 31 Oct 2026). 73 recipes. The list shows discovered dishes first, then the undiscovered ones by method; an undiscovered dish shows only its method, a silhouette and three '?' ingredient slots. Counts read frame by frame: 16 discovered + 18 Grilling, 20 Boiling, 19 Slicing undiscovered. The discovered ones fall in the same method order (7 Grilling, 6 Boiling, 3 Slicing), giving 25 Grilling, 26 Boiling, 22 Slicing (method of Assorted..., Potato Pizza and Grilled Cla... inferred from that order; not seen opened). Full names read from David's Cookbook details video.
rules: 3 slots, one ingredient each: a recipe uses 1-3 ingredients.

Each slot accepts substitutes of the same category (David). The 'Materials to change' list only showed some of them on screen, but the details video used Aged Game Meat and Bird Meat in Meat Stew and Aqualily, Waveleaf Cabbage and Radish in Seafood Stew, so the earlier note that the list is fixed per slot was wrong (corrected 31 Oct 2026).
Dish stars follow the ingredients' stars (up to 5): 3x Boar Meat (4 stars) -> 5-star Meat Stew; 3x Bird Eggs (2 stars) -> 3-star Hard-boiled Egg, 3x Goose Eggs (3 stars) -> 4-star.
Cooking an unknown combination discovers the dish: Round Eggplant + Shrimp Flesh + Bird Meat, Grilling -> Steak Set Meal (3 stars, Recovery).
Effect badges in the list: red + = Recovery, green sword = Attack (team buffs), teal = Familiar stamina, pink = revive.

starRule.rule: Dish stars = 1 + floor(sum of the ingredients' stars / 3). Checked on 45 combinations in David's Cookbook video (31 Oct 2026), all match.
starRule.consequence: A 1-ingredient dish can reach at most 2 stars (one 4-star ingredient), a 2-ingredient dish 3 stars, a 3-ingredient dish 5 stars (three 4-star ingredients; Boar Meat is the only 4-star ingredient seen so far).

effectsByStars.note: Effect per dish star, read from the Cookbook. No single formula: each dish has its own table. Stamina dishes step by 5 or 10 points.
